audience: HR teams that keep employee records, time tracking and absences in Sesame HR

useCases.title: Look up employees by department or office
useCases.text: List active employees, filtered by department, office or entity group. Open one employee for the full profile.

useCases.title: Review pending absence and vacation requests
useCases.text: List absence and vacation requests filtered by status. Then read the vacation calendar of each employee for the days taken and allowed.

useCases.title: Report worked hours for a date range
useCases.text: Report worked, due and balance seconds per employee for a date range. List the clock-in and clock-out entries behind the report.

useCases.title: Find attendance exceptions to review
useCases.text: List check incidences that are pending or revised. Read the shift assignments for a date range to see the planned shifts.

useCases.title: Confirm the connection and the company setup
useCases.text: Show the company behind the API token. List the offices and the geofenced locations used for clock-in.
